title: Redteaming Leading Arabic LLMs with ASAS
abstract: arXiv:2608.21985v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the adoption of large language models (LLMs) grows in Arabic-speaking regions, ensuring their safety and cultural alignment is increasingly critical. However, Arabic LLM safety remains underexplored, especially in adversarial evaluation settings. We introduce the Arabic Safety Index (ASAS), the first fully human-curated Arabic benchmark for redteaming LLMs. ASAS contains 801 prompts spanning 8 safety categories and 8 attack strategies, with ideal responses in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). We conduct a redteaming evaluation across seven leading models with Arabic capabilities, including GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and regional models such as ALLaM and FANAR. Human annotators rate responses using a structured 4-point safety scale, revealing that most models fail to defend against 50% of unsafe prompts. Our findings highlight major safety gaps in high-harm categories such as weapons and illicit substances, with direct and obfuscation-base

translated_title: 对领先阿拉伯语大语言模型进行红队测试：ASAS基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21985v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着大语言模型（LLMs）在阿拉伯语地区的应用日益增长，确保其安全性和文化一致性变得愈发关键。然而，阿拉伯语LLM的安全性研究仍不充分，尤其是在对抗性评估场景中。我们引入了阿拉伯语安全指数（ASAS），这是首个完全由人工整理的用于红队测试LLM的阿拉伯语基准。ASAS包含801个提示，覆盖8个安全类别和8种攻击策略，并提供现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的理想回答。我们对七款具备阿拉伯语能力的领先模型进行了红队评估，包括GPT-4o、Claude 3.7 Sonnet，以及区域模型如ALLaM和FANAR。人类标注员使用结构化的4分制安全量表对回答进行评分，结果显示大多数模型未能抵御50%的不安全提示。我们的发现突出了高危害类别（如武器和非法物质）中的重大安全漏洞，且直接和混淆性攻击均表现出明显问题。
tldr: 本文提出了首个完全人工整理的阿拉伯语安全基准ASAS，通过评估七款领先模型发现它们在应对不安全提示时存在显著防御不足，尤其在武器和非法物质等高危害类别中。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ASAS, the first fully human-curated Arabic safety benchmark, and reveals that seven leading models fail to defend against 50% of unsafe prompts, with major gaps in high-harm categories like weapons and illicit substances.
